desc: Implement O(N log N) solution: classify Moff/Mon/Opt, compute a, SO, pairMin, C0, K0, g(o), beta(o), and the incremental top-k evaluation, output best.
Verify on Sample 1 (16), Sample 2 (0), Sample 3 (2867); sanity-check tiny beneficial-Opt case.
Ensure code reads from stdin and writes only the answer to stdout, handles N up to 2e5, uses Python big ints, sorts efficiently, avoids O(N^2).
